The hero (Melting ice block monolith) stands alone in an empty 5 x 6 m area (Central void); the route circles it and never comes closer than 2.7 m.
Four product stations (Skincare discovery stations) sit at the outer corners, outside the loop, so you turn away from the hero to reach them.
The pay desk (Minimal transaction counter) closes the loop at the back wall.

args.title: Glacial Echoes
args.subtitle: A glacial experience for Tamburins.
args.line: In the quiet hum of Tamburins, the glacier speaks through scent and stillness.
args.synopsis: You enter through monolithic pillars, finding yourself instantly suspended in a field of cold, diffused light. At the center, the Melting ice block monolith slowly wanes, casting shifting shadows upon the polished concrete. You drift through the space, where every corner offers a moment of reflection and discovery. As the scent of the glacier surrounds you, time seems to dissolve along with the ice.
args.quote: Where beauty melts, time slows down.

why.d: The threshold creates a deliberate pause, marking the transition from the bustling city into the serene, chilled atmosphere of the store.
The central monolith acts as the heart of the space, drawing your eye with its delicate, persistent transformation.
These peripheral stations invite you to explore the collection, creating a rhythmic journey between the central hero and the individual product experiences.
The back-positioned desk offers a final, grounded interaction, completing the loop of your journey.
